notes: Drafted comprehensive test plan for Section 3.6 (PWA Capabilities) in the Phase 4 priority plan. Previously the section was a sparse 12-line stub. Now contains 233 test scenarios across 12 subsections: 3.6.1 Module Interface (PWACacheUtils.js with pure functions), 3.6.2 Pure Function Tests (87 tests: config constants, isAppShellURL, isImageURL, routeRequest, computeCacheKey, shouldCacheResponse, getCacheName, validateManifest), 3.6.3 Manifest Validation (31 tests: required fields, icons, theme colors, HTML link tags), 3.6.4 Service Worker Lifecycle (16 tests: file structure, registration, activation), 3.6.5 Cache Strategy (25 tests: shell cache-first, image cache network-first, version bump invalidation, passthrough), 3.6.6 Integration (14 tests: shell+SW integration, image upload+cache, update detection), 3.6.7 Install Prompt (13 tests: beforeinstallprompt event, install button behavior), 3.6.8 Offline Behavior (15 tests: app functionality offline, graceful degradation), 3.6.9 E2E Playwright (32 tests: SW registration, offline mode, cache validation, update cycle, installability, edge cases, GitHub Pages compatibility), 3.6.10 Priority Ordering (P0/P1/P2), 3.6.11 Known Behaviors (10 documented behaviors), 3.6.12 Total Test Count Summary (233 tests). Also added deferred automated verification, deferred manual verification, and deferred critical files sections to Section 6 of the plan. Used world-review subagent for UX perspective on PWA risks (stale cache, cache bloat, subdirectory scoping) and planner subagent for comprehensive test scenario design. Key design decisions: PWACacheUtils.js extracts pure functions from SW logic for browser-based unit testing; CDN dependencies (Vue, PureCSS, Google Fonts) use passthrough routing (not cached); image cache uses LRU eviction with MAX_IMAGE_CACHE_SIZE=50 and 7-day TTL; cache version bump invalidates all caches.
